visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a bustling shopping mall with a group of people standing before a Japanese-style food stall. The stall is decorated with light wood and a small red and white flag. A woman in a dark purple shirt and white pants stands with her back to the camera, looking at the display. (2) The camera zooms into a refrigerated display case containing numerous triangular rice balls. Each onigiri is wrapped in individual plastic with pink and green labels. A label reads "味噌佃煮." The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the rice and fillings visible through the packaging. (3) A middle-aged woman with dark reddish-brown hair, wearing a traditional blue floral yukata, is seen behind the counter. She wears transparent plastic gloves and is skillfully shaping a mound of white rice with her hands. The background shows a clean, organized kitchen area. (4) The woman in the yukata smiles warmly at the camera, presenting a large, seaweed-wrapped onigiri held in both hands. Her expression is welcoming. The background is a soft-focus greenery, suggesting an outdoor or garden-themed area nearby. (5) A rapid montage shows close-ups of various rice balls. One is purple with perilla seeds, another is being split open to reveal salmon and cod roe. The hands of the presenter are visible, pulling the rice apart to show the rich fillings. (6) A different woman with a pink patterned headband and white shirt is seen looking at the display case from the customer side. She points at the onigiri. The video ends with a shot of the storefront and an informative text graphic detailing the store's location and dates.
